headline: CPP Investments to invest ₹3,000 crore in Prestige Hospitality Ventures; Trilegal, CAM advise
sum: Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPP Investments) is set to invest ₹3,000 crore in Prestige Hospitality Ventures Limited, the hospitality platform of Prestige Estates. Trilegal advised the Canadian Pension Plan Investment Board on…
detail: Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPP Investments) is set to invest ₹3,000 crore in Prestige Hospitality Ventures Limited, the hospitality platform of Prestige Estates. Trilegal advised the Canadian Pension Plan Investment Board on this transaction. The Firm advised on corporate, operational and real estate due diligence, CCI filing, and drafting and negotiation of the transaction documents. The transaction was led by Sai Krishna Bharathan (Partner), with support from Raina Mitra (Senior Associate), Associates Archi Jain and Annika Bohra.
